sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can suggest doing something together using the -junk/-jünk imperative as a question, and react to a suggestion.
I can say "I would..." using the -nék ending, including irregular verbs like enni, inni, and menni.
I can aim advice at a specific person using neked/neki kellene, or soften it with the 2nd-person conditional.
I can conjugate the conditional for every person, regular and irregular verbs alike.
I can build a hypothetical "if" sentence with ha, and wish a situation were different with jobb lenne/jó lenne, ha...
